name: prompt-coach
description: Quiet hints on your draft: when a prompt in the box leaves something real to guess, one dim line says what is worth adding. No scores, no buttons, never holds a prompt back.

mode.title: Hints
mode.description: on: a quiet line under a draft that leaves something to guess; off: no hints

threshold.title: Hint below
threshold.description: Hint on drafts rated below this score (1 to 5); 3 hints on 1 and 2
